verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents a streaming STT API where you hold a handle and push microphone frames as they arrive (runanywhere-docs-22), alongside one-shot transcription and VAD. It also states that speech models run on-device with audio staying on the phone and working offline (runanywhere-docs-3). A hands-on user reports voice commands being heard and acted on in rcli (runanywhere-comm-4), and the vendor says its engine handles STT natively (runanywhere-comm-6). Missing for 10: detailed docs on partial/interim results and latency, and independent hands-on corroboration of real-time dictation accuracy and speed.
